title: Evaluation modulo a natural number
statement: Let $C$ be an algebraic circuit on $n$ inputs, let $a$ assign a natural number to each input, and let $k$ be a natural number. Evaluating $C$ on the reductions of the inputs modulo $k$ gives the reduction modulo $k$ of its integer evaluation on $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural-number assignment to each of the `n` inputs
